prompt: Write a function `renderWidget(container, component)` that creates an instance of the given Angular component dynamically and inserts it into the supplied ViewContainerRef, returning the created component reference.

Write an injectable Angular service `ModalService` with an `open(component)` method that creates the given component dynamically at runtime and attaches it so it can be displayed as a modal. Expose a `close()` that destroys it.

Write a function `mountWithInputs(container, component, inputs)` that dynamically creates the component inside the given ViewContainerRef, applies each key of `inputs` to the created instance, and returns the component reference.

Write a function `mountToBody(component, injector, appRef)` that creates the given Angular component dynamically without a ViewContainerRef, attaches its host view to the ApplicationRef so it is change-detected, and appends its root DOM node to document.body.
